description: Energy consumption for fixed installations is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. These data show monthly energy consumption (in MWh) for Infrabel's and third parties' fixed installations.Infrabel, for its own buildings, signalling and points heating, among othersThird parties, for stations and workshops of SNCB and container terminals, among others. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Energie, Gebouwen, Vaste installaties. The portal shows 180 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
